proposals.quote: As discussed in our Application (see EvalEconCaliber5.HardRock.RetailRecOther), HRMP will unlock further development potential within Metropolitan Park by delivering a parking podium on which Queens Baseball Company (i.e., the New York Mets) will then build the Taste of Queens.

Detailed design for the interior of the Taste of Queens is still underway. We currently anticipate that the market (“food hall”) will be located on the elevated first floor, directly accessible and visible from the MTA gateway plaza as well as the open space.
As part of Metropolitan Park, an affiliate of the New York Mets expects to build Taste of Queens—a food and entertainment space.

As part of its agreement with the City of New York and local community stakeholders and officials, Hard Rock will construct a parking podium immediately adjacent to Citi Field, that will facilitate the future construction above.

While Hard Rock Metropolitan Park will not control the development above the podium, Queens Baseball Company, the current leaseholder of Citi Field Stadium and the adjacent parking lots at the development site will build "Taste of Queens" at the location pursuant to a Letter of Intent signed by Queens Baseball Company and Hard Rock Metropolitan Park which can be found in EvalEconCaliber5.HardRock.RetailRecOther.Attachment-3.

The Taste of Queens will be an at least 30,000 sq. ft. food hall with at least 20 vending stalls and a restaurant space, which will bring the culinary diversity of Queens directly to Metropolitan Park.

Further, HRMP plans to construct an overbuild with a construction cost of approximately $60 million as part of one of the casino’s garages, to serve as the platform for a Taste of Queens food hall that is being built by the New York Mets.
The Board’s full expectation is that the Taste of Queens is completed as it was a strong commitment made during the CAC process.
